subject: ela
intro: Evaluate advantages and disadvantages of mediums.

items.prompt:
Video is especially good for showing:
A) motion and action
B) a single searchable fact
C) dense footnotes

Text is especially easy to:
A) search and skim for a fact
B) show motion
C) play sound
items.answer: A) search and skim for a fact

solution.answer: A) search and skim for a fact

items.prompt:
Every medium has strengths and:
A) weaknesses
B) no limits
C) the same abilities

For teaching how to tie a knot, an ADVANTAGE of video over text is that it:
A) shows the motion step by step
B) is easier to search
C) uses less data
items.answer: A) shows the motion step by step

steps: Video shows motion. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) shows the motion step by step

items.prompt:
A DISADVANTAGE of video for looking up one quick fact is that it:
A) is hard to skim or search
B) shows too much detail
C) has no sound
items.answer: A) is hard to skim or search

steps: Can't scan a video. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) is hard to skim or search

items.prompt:
An advantage of a TEXT article is that it:
A) is easy to search, skim, and reread
B) always shows motion
C) plays music
items.answer: A) is easy to search, skim, and reread

steps: Text is searchable. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) is easy to search, skim, and reread

items.prompt:
A journalist wants to convey both detailed statistics AND the emotional impact of a disaster. The BEST choice is likely:
A) a multimedia piece combining text/charts with video interviews
B) a single still photo
C) a list of numbers only
items.answer: A) a multimedia piece combining text/charts with video interviews

solution.answer: A) a multimedia piece combining text/charts with video interviews

items.prompt:
When evaluating which medium to use, the KEY is to:
A) match each medium's strengths and weaknesses to the topic and audience
B) always pick video
C) always pick text
items.answer: A) match each medium's strengths and weaknesses to the topic and audience

steps: Fit medium to purpose. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) match each medium's strengths and weaknesses to the topic and audience
